 If You Chase Results Instead Of Hype, Reviewers Say These 30 Affordable Korean Beauty Products Just Plain Work
 Your beauty routine has standards. Your bank account has boundaries. Meet the K-beauty finds that honor both!
 Posted on Nov 13, 2026 UTC 
 Facebook 
 Pinterest 
 Link 
 by Maria Gutierrez Orozco BuzzFeed BuzzFeed Staff I'm a BuzzFeed Shopping resident writer with a background in journalism and PR who is always looking for affordable finds and things that make life a little easier, prettier, or more fun.
 1. A Mise En Scene shine-boosting hair serum for smoother, softer, and noticeably glossier hair. It's made with a blend of camellia, marula, jojoba, apricot, olive, coconut, and argan oils to help nourish damaged hair and protect it from heat styling. Reviewers rave about how silky it makes their hair feel and how they can't get enough of the delicious scent.
 www.amazon.com , www.amazon.com Promising reviews: " The scent is nice. I'd give this 10 stars if I could. I've been using salon products for over a decade, and this is way better. And cheaper. I've even gotten compliments on how silky smooth my hair looks. I put it on while my hair is wet, then again when I style, if my hair gets frizzy from my flat-iron, and to tame flyaways. It's my favorite hair product I own." — Amy Wilt 
 "IT WORKS! I am in my eighties and have gray, fizzy hair (used to be smooth, wavy blond hair), and I have tried so many different products to smooth the fizz from my hair. Nothing worked. This product did!!! — Darlene Sharpe 
 Get it from Amazon for  $15.86+  (available in four sizes and eight other formulas).
 2. A TirTir cushion foundation  to blur redness, blemishes, and dark circles while leaving your skin looking fresh and even. Its lightweight formula is infused with hibiscus flower and red propolis to help support elasticity, delivering up to 72 hours of comfortable wear and a soft satin finish. Whether you're after an everyday look or something with a little more coverage, reviewers say it layers beautifully without feeling heavy. 
 www.amazon.com , www.amazon.com Want to lock everything in place? Pair it with the TirTir Mask Fit Makeup Fixer setting spray for an even longer-lasting, more matte finish.
 Check out this TikTok of Mikayla Nogueira's review of this foundation.
 Promising review: "This is my first time trying Korean makeup, and I’m very happy with my purchase! It feels like nothing I’ve ever tried before. I have oily skin, and this isn’t a matte product, but it’s not dewy either, which I love. It’s moisturizing, but not oily at all. I think any skin type can use it. It’s literally perfect. The application and the cushion made it go on my skin flawlessly. I wish I could give this 10 stars; it really exceeded my expectations! It will definitely be a staple in my makeup routine now." — Cathy 
 Get it from Amazon for $18.75  (available in two sizes, 40 shades, a  matte finish , a  dewy finish , and sample kits to find your best shade match).
 3. A super cute,  The Saem refreshing eye stick that'll instantly de-puff tired under-eyes with a burst of lightweight hydration. This formula combines Icelandic glacier water for a cooling refresh, hyaluronic acid to lock in moisture, niacinamide to brighten, and Icelandic moss to help soothe the skin. Perfect for those early mornings when your eyes could use a little pick-me-up!
 www.amazon.com , www.amazon.com Oh, but it doesn't stop there — it can also help smooth the appearance of fine lines. Pro tip! Pop it in the fridge for an extra cooling, de-puffing boost.
 Promising review: "I have eczema around my eyes, and they are always red, dry, flaky, and puffy. This is the first product that I have tried that has healed my eyes! In less than one week, my eyes were completely transformed!  I would give this more than 5 stars if I could!!!! " — amy 
 "Great results. It hasn’t been a month, and I have seen so much improvement it’s shocking. I use it twice a day, and I leave it in the fridge that it's cold when I apply it. Whenever I am home, I use it more often." — Fabiola Burgos  
 Get it from Amazon for $12.50+  (also available in two other versions and sets).
 4. A magical Touch in Sol No Poreblem primer designed to minimize the look of pores, smooth uneven texture, and create the perfect canvas so your makeup glides on effortlessly. And if your foundation always catches on dry patches, this can help by adding hydration without leaving your skin greasy. Need proof? Just look at the orange below. 
 www.instagram.com , www.amazon.com Promising review: "You. Need. This. Primer. I never leave reviews, but I had to praise this product. This is seriously a holy grail staple for your makeup. I've tried dozens of primers, and none have even come close to this. It doesn't matter if you're using oil-based or silicone-based makeup. It will all blend and sit seamlessly. I have dry skin and oily skin, so finding something that suits both needs is hard. It doesn't get patchy either, which is something I struggle with. But THIS primer is absolutely perfect. 10/10. Would give 100 stars if I could!! " — Placeholder 
 Get it from Amazon for  $14.99  (also available; the Primer Prep version and the green color-correcting primer  for redness).
 5. An Elizabeth Mott Thank Me Later eye primer that helps prevent creasing and keeps excess oil in check, so your look stays vibrant and flawless all day — and even all night. Reviewers love how it keeps their eye makeup looking fresh for 10+ hours, with many calling it a rival to (or an even better option than)  Urban Decay's cult-favorite Eyeshadow Primer Potion . 
 www.amazon.com Elizabeth Mott  is owned by Korean American Alice Kim and partners with top Korean manufacturers to bring affordable yet effective K-beauty products to the U.S.
 Promising review:  "This eye primer is amazing!!! I have super oily eyelids and was getting to the point that I would rarely bother with eyeshadow because even with expensive primers it would be smudged and creased within an hour. So glad I don't need to shell out for Urban Decay or Mac Paint Pot anymore; they don't hold a candle to this and it's so much cheaper. " — Chloe 
 Get it from Amazon for  $14.99  (available in six formulas and two set combos).
 6. A fan-favorite  Cosrx snail serum  packed with 96.3% snail secretion filtrate and hydration-boosting ingredients like hyaluronic acid and panthenol to help repair skin and bring back that healthy glow. Plus, it absorbs quickly without leaving that *yucky*, sticky feeling. In fact, reviewers can't stop raving about how it has earned a permanent spot in their routine. 🐌 ✨ 
 www.amazon.com Promising review: "Cured my dry skin in one day. ONE DAY. I can’t believe how good this stuff is. It’s absolutely incredible. It is super moisturizing but doesn’t leave any greasy feeling, is gentle on my sensitive skin, and leaves it so smooth and glowing. I told everyone I know to buy this.  I would give it 10 million stars if I could. " — Leviiiii 
 Get it from Amazon for  $18.50  (available in a pack of two).
 7. An I Dew Care mattifying dry shampoo  formulated with root-boosting powder, black ginseng, and biotin to lift flat roots, cut down on excess oil, and make it hard to believe you're already on day four post-wash! Just tap into your roots, blend it in with your fingertips, and you're good to go — one little touch-up that'll leave your hair smelling and looking great!  
 www.amazon.com Promising review:  "I've always needed dry shampoo for my top roots, which get oily far before the rest of my hair. I relied on aerosol products, never considering the dangerous chemicals I was breathing. After the recall, I began to look for safe options and tried a few that weren't that great. THIS is by FAR the best I've ever used. The applicator is genius — it goes on so easily. And I've NEVER had a dry shampoo last like this for DAYS! It's easy to work in with my fingers, and it is a wonderful volumizer. The size is great for travel. I hope they never change the formula — it is just wonderful — even the very light, delicate fragrance is perfect.  I give it 100 STARS for its safety, convenience, design, AND for all the time it saves me. " — Lexi Jean  
 Get it from Amazon for $15.99  (available in six shades and a refill option). 
 8. An  Anua Heartleaf pore-purifying cleansing oil that melts away makeup, sunscreen, excess oil, and all sorts of impurities in one simple step — while being gentle on all skin types. And if you've been avoiding cleansing oils because you're worried they'll cause breakouts, reviewers with acne-prone skin say this one proved them wrong.  
 www.amazon.com , www.amazon.com Oh, and if you're curious about reviewers mentioning double cleansing, it's simply a two-step routine that starts with an oil formula and finishes with a  water-based cleanser .
 Promising review: "I'm in my early 40s and have been dealing with skin issues since my preteen years, so we're talking three decades of struggles. I noticed an improvement with my very first use, and it's only continued getting better. It's corrected texture problems I thought would never be solved. I'm about two weeks in, and my skin is clearer and smoother than it's been in a loooong time. I have sensitive skin, so for a few days, my face was a little cranky, but everything has settled nicely enough that I even bought the moisturizer, too. I use the cleansing oil in the evenings and the moisturizer in the mornings, along with my regular face wash, and I'm so happy! I'd give this 10 stars if possible! " — Amazon Customer 
 Get it from Amazon for $17 .
 9. An Elizavecca hair-coating treatment made with collagen, protein, and ceramides to help repair damage, smooth frizz, and leave hair noticeably softer after just one use. Just leave it on for about five minutes, rinse, and say hello to silkier, shinier strands and probably your best hair day ever.
 Bek O'Connell / BuzzFeed, www.amazon.com And it seems to work well for all hair types, too! One reviewer with 4c curls says it left their coils softer, shinier, and more defined, while another one with naturally straight hair noticed smoother, healthier-looking strands after just one use.
 Promising review:  "Brought this product after seeing it on BuzzFeed. After first use, I saw an immediate difference; my dry/damaged hair felt soft and healthy.  Would rate six stars if I could! " — Natalie 
 Read BuzzFeed Shopping editor Bek O'Connell's review of the  Elizavecca CER-100 Collagen Coating Hair Protein Treatment to see why she calls it "the miracle product I've been searching for." 
 Get it from Amazon for $6.99 .
 10. A Cosrx Vitamin E sunscreen with SPF 50 that will help protect your skin from daily UV exposure and leave it hydrated without feeling greasy or leaving a white cast. Future you will be glad you didn't skip it!  
 www.amazon.com Promising reviews: "I absolutely love this sunscreen! It goes on so smoothly and doesn’t leave a white cast, which is a huge win for my skin tone. It feels lightweight, yet provides excellent protection throughout the day. My skin feels hydrated, not greasy, and it works perfectly under makeup. I’ve been using it daily and have noticed no irritation. Definitely a must-have in my skincare routine." — Annie 
 Get it from Amazon for $18.40 (available in a two-pack, a keyring gift set, and a stick version).
 11. A The Face Shoap foaming cleanser with rice water and vitamins A, B, and E that leaves your complexion brighter and softer without the tight, over-washed feeling afterward. Plus, it transforms into a creamy lather that can help clear pore-clogging buildup for a deep cleanse before you catch some Z's!
 www.amazon.com , www.amazon.com Promising review: " Not any of the many I’ve tried throughout my life have worked as incredibly as this one has . I’ve had top recommended brand cleansers that required two washes to thoroughly cleanse it all off. Not with this one. And the scent is wonderful!! I love it even more for that! The size of the bottle is much bigger than I expected, and for such a great price!! Highly recommended!" — Carlos 
 Get it from Amazon for  $11.88+ (available in two sizes and two-pack versions).
 12. A pair of  Plantifique moisturizing foot mask socks packed with coconut oil, shea butter, and avocado extract to help rough, cracked heels feel softer in one easy 20-minute session. Slip them on while you binge-watch Netflix or answer some texts. By the time they come off, your heels will feel smoother, suuuper hydrated, and a lot less neglected! 
 www.amazon.com , www.amazon.com Promising review: "My feet have been dryyyyy since having my kiddos (maybe hormonal, idk) and I've been using the metal grater regularly, lotions and creams nightly, pedicures with callus removal monthly, the list goes on. I'm shocked at how well these socks work! One time used so far, and my feet feel amazing! Better than all the other things I mentioned. I didn't get the peel ones cuz I've done that once and don't feel like dealing with the peeling, so I'm talking about the non-peel moisturizing socks. Get them! Take 30 minutes of chilling with them before sleep time, and you'll love your feet!" — EB 
 Get two pairs from Amazon for $9.99  (also available in larger packs).
 13. A TikTok favorite, Nooni Appleberry lip oil featuring a glossy, effortless berry wash to instantly elevate your natural look without spending time on a full lip combo — and many reviewers say that once you try it, you'll never look back! 
 www.amazon.com , www.amazon.com Check out this TikTok of the Appleberry lip oil in action.
 Bonus: it's made without sulfates, phthalates, or parabens, and it's vegan and cruelty-free!
 Promising review: "This is the first lip oil I've ever used. Usually, I avoid anything with oil because I have very sensitive and generally oilier skin, but I wanted to give this a try because I wanted something sheer and pretty for a natural makeup look. Probably the best purchase I've ever made!!! It's super sheer and looks fine on its own without any other makeup. The smell is delicious, and while the gloss dries and fades after about an hour or two without eating, the color stays all day! I did have to reapply after eating, but not after drinking water! I just wish it were bigger, it's a teeny bottle. Would definitely buy again!!" — Debby Gold 
 Get it from Amazon for  $15  (available in 13 shades and multipacks).
 14. A  Laneige Lip Glowy Balm with shea and murumuru seed butters to give your lips lightweight moisture and a glossy shine without the sticky feeling. Wear it solo for a soft, tinted look during the day, then layer it over your favorite lipstick at night for a juicier finish.  
 Amazon, www.amazon.com Promising review:  "Everyone needs this lip gloss in their lives. It honestly makes your lips feel so good. I have one with my makeup and one in my purse to take everywhere with me. It's glossy but not sticky. It feels light on, but makes your lips instantly feel more nourished . Worth every penny." — Britney Badger 
 Get it from Amazon for  $19  (available in 10 shades and in two gift set versions).
 15. Or a  Tocobo lip balm made for dry, chapped lips that need lasting moisture and a glowy upgrade. The jojoba and avocado oils give that cushiony, nourishing feel without making your lips feel weighed down. Swipe it on before you start your day or before bed to help seal in moisture. Fair warning: your other lip balms might start feeling a little left out. 
 Amazon, www.amazon.com BuzzFeed Shopping editor Jenae Sitzes shares, "This is one of my fave new everyday lip products. I have it in Tangerine Red , and the color is soft and subtle — I like that I can take it out and apply it without having to look in a mirror, like you would with lipstick — but at the same time, it makes a huge difference, making my lips look hydrated and my whole face more ~alive~ (especially on no-makeup days)."
 Promising review: " Best lip balm I ever used!  The color development is subtle, so it's good to use for bare face makeup, and I think it would be good to apply as a base!! As far as moisturizing power, it has good retention and it's hypoallergenic. I recommend to those who don't wear heavy makeup, those who are looking for a moist, colored lip balm." — Y.Lee 
 Get it from Amazon for  $11.87+  (also available in seven shades).
 16. A Meditherapy skin booster serum formulated with retinal (a more potent form of retinol) that can help visibly soften wrinkles, refine skin texture, and shrink the look of pores. Actually, reviewers say they're noticing a smoother complexion in just a few days. And to balance that strength, soothing centella asiatica helps keep it gentle on sensitive skin, while niacinamide helps deliver a brighter, more even-looking tone."  
 www.amazon.com , Amazon Even though this formula is meant to be gentle, retinal is still no joke, so start slow and patch test before going all in. If your skin is cool with it, apply it after cleansing and build up nightly use from there.
 Promising review: "Honestly, buy it. I was skeptical about this serum, especially since it’s such a large bottle for so cheap, plus this was a leap of faith for me since I do have sensitive skin. I’ve been using this religiously for over a week now, and even after the first day, I could see and feel the improvement of my skin. I went from having small red breakouts to clear, even skin almost overnight. I’m not even wearing makeup now because I love the look and glow to my skin. I don’t even do reviews, but this product deserves it 100%. I will be purchasing again. BUY IT!" — Boogs 
 Get it from Amazon for $19.99 .
 17. A jar of Anua toner pads featuring heartleaf water and PHA to calm irritated skin, gently lift away dead skin cells, and control pore-clogging buildup. Your complexion is left looking clearer and suuuper smooth — thanks in part to the pads' embossed texture that helps gently exfoliate your skin. Plus, reviewers are so impressed that one even mentions, " ✨If I could only keep one skincare product, it would honestly be these pads.✨ "  
 www.amazon.com , www.amazon.com Promising reviews: "This has been THEEE best product for my dry, sensitive skin. These pads are brightening and helped my uneven skin texture . I didn’t know these pads would change my skin completely!! I’ll be repurchasing forever, best skincare product I’ve used in a long time, you NEED THIS! You’ll immediately notice a difference." — Kenny Vasquez 
 "When I tell you my skin hasn’t been this clear in forever. I have PCOS and hirsutism, which causes me to grow hair on my neck and chin. I’m also a skin picker, so clearing my skin has been really difficult for me. But this product has saved my skin . I’m still working on my skin picking, but when I don’t, these pads help to exfoliate and help with the dark marks. Thank Anua !" — Jessyca Renee 
 Get it from Amazon for $21.88  (available in five different formulas).
 18. A fan-favorite  Some by Mi Miracle toner with tea tree water and a trio of mild exfoliants to help acne-prone skin look clearer and feel less congested. Together, these ingredients help unclog pores, clear away buildup, and exfoliate gently. Reviewers keep coming back to it, saying it helped clear up breakouts and made their pores look smaller!
 www.amazon.com , www.amazon.com After cleansing, dampen a cotton pad with the toner and gently sweep it over your face, then pat in any leftover product before finishing with moisturizer.
 Promising review: "This stuff works! First off, there was no purging period, which my acne-prone skin is grateful for. It also doesn't sting or smell harsh. Within a week of using this toner, I stopped having breakouts . My dark spots are slowly getting lighter, and my skin is starting to glow. I'm on my second bottle now, and I have nothing but good things to say. I really hope they never stop making this." — kem 
 Get it from Amazon for   $16.80+  (available in a two-pack).
 19. A Beauty of Joseon eye serum that can help tired under-eyes look less puffy, soften the appearance of fine lines, and brighten up your whole eye area. You can thank the ginseng water, retinal liposomes, and niacinamide for doing all the heavy lifting. The real kicker? It can be used on your entire face to help with skin firmness.
 www.amazon.com As someone with pretty stubborn dark circles, I've tried a lot of under-eye products, and this is one of my favorites. I mostly use it at night, but on mornings when I didn't sleep well — which is most nights — I'll apply a little and notice the de-puffing effect a few minutes later. 
 Promising review:  " This eye cream makes my eyes so soft, it has this luxurious feel that is better than any high-end product I have tried and for the cost? This stuff is unbelievable. I tried Ogee and all sorts of products that people swear by, but this one keeps my eyes hydrated and soft all night and lasts until the next day. It also isn’t greasy which I love. Since it has retinol I only put on at night and use a vitamin C serum by murad in the morning. I love this product! You can feel and see a different after one use." — AJ 
 Get it from Amazon for  $17+  (available in two sizes).
 20. A  Torriden serum formulated with five types of hyaluronic acid to give thirsty skin lightweight but powerful hydration and leave it looking plump, dewy, and fresh without any sticky finish. The texture absorbs fast and layers easily under moisturizer or makeup, so it feels like adding a big drink of water to your skin instead of just another heavy skincare step.
 www.amazon.com Promising review: " Disclaimer: I went on Accutane five years ago, and this product is one of several other products in my day/night skincare routine. I first picked this up at an Olive Young store during a trip I took to South Korea. It was listed as one of their best-sellers, and I 100% can see why. I mist my face before applying a few drops, and it absorbs really quickly. Almost immediately, my skin looks/feels more hydrated and prepped for the rest of my routine . The days where I feel lazy and don’t complete my skincare routine or cheat and not use this, my face definitely looks less dewy/a little more dull. Idk but I’m sold for sure." — Jaylen 
 Get it from Amazon for  $22.50  (also available in a two-pack and refill set).
 21. An Etude barrier intensive cream ready to calm sensitive skin, support your moisture barrier, and help your face feel more comfortable when it's dry or reactive. Reviewers love its rich, creamy texture that also absorbs quickly without leaving your skin greasy. That light-but-comforting feel comes from a blend of panthenol (aka provitamin B5) and a centella-derived ingredient to help smooth and hydrate. 
 www.amazon.com , Amazon Bonus points: It's fragrance-free and perfect for all skin types.
 Promising review: " My new favorite moisturizer. It doesn't leave skin greasy. It instantly makes my skin comfortable and calm. It is unscented and leaves skin with a good texture. Works much better than much more expensive alternatives." — Carolyn Raney Mason 
 Get it from Amazon for  $20.99+  (available in two sizes, a two pack, a lightweight version and a toner duo set).
 22. A magical bottle of Mixsoon Bean Essence serum , powered by fermented soybean, barley, pomegranate, and Korean pear, that gently exfoliates rough texture and leaves your complexion looking glowy, hydrated, and really smooth!  
 www.amazon.com And if you want to round out your Mixsoon skincare routine, check out their  moisturizer , and sunscreen  too!
 Promising reviews: " I saw this all over TikTok/Instagram and decided to buy it because I have a lot of sebaceous filaments on my chin and nose. It's a little expensive but I took a gamble: it works! You can physically see the sebaceous filaments come out of your pores, it is not the product bunching up. My problem areas were so much smoother after using and are left with a moisturized glow. I then proceeded to have my boyfriend use this product to see of it worked this good on everyone on the first try and it worked on his nose as well. Amazing stuff. 🩷" — Losa 
 "I have hyperpigmentation and oily skin. I feel this product regulates my oil production and it helps my makeup look so flawless. 10/10." — MissKayMae 
 Get it from Amazon for  $22  (available in three sizes).
 23. A long-lasting Fwee 3D gloss ready to make your lips look fuller, juicier, and extra glossy without the sticky drama. Each shade comes in two pigment intensities to choose from — a sheer 30% on low-effort days or a bolder 70% when you're in the mood for a high impact. 
 Amazon Promising reviews: "This lip gloss glides on so well! It has a nice pigment, and I love that there are the 30% and 70%, which cater to different preferences . I got three of the 30% and one of the 70% because I like a more natural look. The packaging is also really cute! Korean lippies are the best!" — Sunny 
 " Feels like butter spun into silk on your lips. I have 70% currant , and I love it so much. I will be purchasing more shades! 😍" — Karli 
 Get it from Amazon for  $14.99  (available in 17 colors).
 24. An impressive Some By Mi Body cleanser built to clear body breakouts and get stubborn bacne under control. The AHA/BHA/PHA trio tackles exfoliation and deep pore-clearing, while the tea tree and centella keep your skin calm, so the formula never feels too harsh. Reviewers mention it's not overnight magic, but within a few weeks, they notice a massive improvement in their breakouts and even see old scars starting to fade. 
 www.amazon.com Read more about tea tree oil and acne at Mayo Clinic .
 Promising reviews: "I bought this for my husband, who struggles with back acne and redness, especially after workouts. We weren't expecting instant results, but we took a before/after photo out of curiosity — and were genuinely surprised. After just one use, his skin looked noticeably less red and inflamed . The gel texture is refreshing, has a light tea tree scent (not overpowering), and lathers really well. It rinses clean without leaving any residue or dryness. We’ll keep using it daily to see how it works long-term, but this first impression is honestly impressive. Highly recommend giving it a try if you're looking for a gentle yet effective body acne wash that actually shows results." — Sherry Ann 
 "If you use this constantly, you definitely will see progress with your KP skin. Lathers really well, so one pump is enough. Moisturize after using." — Destiny 
 Get it from Amazon for  $18.70+  (available in two sizes and a body wash, and body soap option).
 25. A  Nature Republic Honey melting lipstick that will deliver a luminous tint that melts on like a balm but gives your lips a plushy, glassy finish 💋 Reviewers say it's actually that good, with some comparing it to the YSL Candy Glaze and the super viral Tarte Maracuja Juicy Lip , except this one gives you that glossy shine too at a waaaay more reasonable price.
 www.instagram.com , www.amazon.com Promising review: " These have become my FAVORITE lip product. They feel like silky jelly on your lips. They don’t dehydrate them or dry them out. They give a gorgeous plumping effect that makes them look bigger and fuller . The colors are nice. I have three different ones and use them all regularly mixing them with lip stains and lipsticks for fun. They combine nicely with other products but again, the fact that they don’t dry my lips out is great!" — Alyssa C. 
 Get it from Amazon for $12.90  (available in 23 colors).
 26. A cult-favorite Biodance collagen hydrogel mask that starts milky-white and gradually turns clear as it sits, letting collagen, hyaluronic acid, and probiotics deeply hydrate to help plump skin, boost elasticity, and minimize the look of pores and fine lines.  Wear it overnight or for three to four hours, depending on if you want a full sleep-in-it treatment or a quick pick-me-up before your plans! 
 www.amazon.com , www.amazon.com Check out a TikTok of Biodance collagen mask in action.
 Promising review: "Oh…my god…. 🤯   No scent. It starts milky white and turns clear. I left it on overnight, woke up, and I was shook!! Pores? Where? Dry patch? Where? Fine wrinkles? Whheeerrrrrre??? I put it on over my lips as well, and it almost looked like I had filler. It was so plump! 10/10 recommend. Holy grail of face masks <3" — Kichi 
 Get a four-count pack from Amazon for  $19 (available in a four and 16-count).
 27. An Anua niacinamide serum formulated to help fade the look of dark spots, balance uneven tone, and make skin look brighter overall. Tranexamic acid and arbutin back up the brightening benefits, while the hyaluronic acid and barrier-supporting ingredients help the complexion feel smooth and calm. You say hyperpigmentation? This puppy says, thank you, next!
